as.pairlist(alist(ranked = , term2gene = , term2name = , seed = , settings = integrationGseaSettings()))
{
    requireOptionalPackage("clusterProfiler", "pathway enrichment")
    integrationEnrichmentCheckRanked(ranked)
    integrationGseaCheckSettings(seed, settings)
    if (!is.data.frame(term2gene) || !all(c("term", "gene") %in% 
        names(term2gene)) || !is.data.frame(term2name) || !all(c("term", 
        "name") %in% names(term2name))) {
        integrationEnrichmentRefuse("integration_enrichment_parameters_invalid", 
            "the pathway tables need term and gene, and term and name, columns")
    }
    values <- stats::setNames(ranked$value, ranked$identifier)
    outcome <- withr::with_seed(seed, {
        values <- sort(values, decreasing = TRUE)
        if (settings$tie_jitter > 0) {
            values <- values + stats::runif(length(values), min = -settings$tie_jitter, 
                max = settings$tie_jitter)
            values <- sort(values, decreasing = TRUE)
        }
        tryCatch(clusterProfiler::GSEA(geneList = values, TERM2GENE = term2gene[, 
            c("term", "gene")], TERM2NAME = term2name[, c("term", 
            "name")], minGSSize = settings$min_size, maxGSSize = settings$max_size, 
            pvalueCutoff = settings$p_cutoff, pAdjustMethod = settings$p_adjust_method, 
            verbose = FALSE), error = function(e) e)
    })
    if (inherits(outcome, "error")) {
        integrationEnrichmentRefuse("integration_enrichment_method_failed", 
            conditionMessage(outcome), engine_message = conditionMessage(outcome))
    }
    terms <- if (is.null(outcome)) 
        integrationEnrichmentEmptyTerms()
    else methods::slot(outcome, "result")
    rownames(terms) <- NULL
    engine <- list(clusterProfiler = as.character(utils::packageVersion("clusterProfiler")), 
        enrichit = tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("enrichit")), 
            error = function(e) NA_character_))
    list(method = "gsea", engine = engine, seed = seed, settings = settings, 
        ranked = data.frame(identifier = ranked$identifier, value = ranked$value, 
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE), terms = terms)
}
